subject: LlamaLink co-bundle: commercial packaging, runtime telemetry & responsibilities
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Herrera <sofia@llamalink.ai>, LlamaLink Partnerships <partnerships@llamalink.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LlamaLink co-bundle: commercial packaging, runtime telemetry & responsibilities

Hi Sofia / LlamaLink team,

Great meeting last week — thanks for the demo. We left a few open questions around how a co-packaged SDK offering would be split between product, runtime and GTM responsibilities. To keep momentum, I sketched a short outline (attached) with three decision areas:

1) Commercial packaging: pricing tiers, entitlements, and referral revenue split.
2) Runtime telemetry: what tracing hooks we’ll ship in the SDK, what Redwood maintains in-host vs. what LlamaLink owns.
3) Support & SLAs: escalation paths, who handles observability triage, and DocuSign/SOW cadence.

As next steps could you confirm:
- Which telemetry APIs you can commit to support in Q3? (trace context, span sampling, prefix cache metrics)
- Whether LlamaLink wants a co-branded SDK or a Redwood-hosted wrapper?
- Your typical licensing window and POC to GA timeline.

I’ve attached a quick commercial outline and a draft rolespec for telemetry; looping in Marissa for GTM and Karthik for runtime traces. Looking for a quick alignment call next week to lock responsibilities.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: llamalink-commercial-outline-v1.pdf, telemetry-rolespec-rlv1.md
From: Sofia Herrera <sofia@llamalink.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LlamaLink Partnerships <partnerships@llamalink.ai>, Evan Chu <evan@consultly.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LlamaLink co-bundle: commercial packaging, runtime telemetry & responsibilities

Hi Kimberly — great to hear from you and thanks for the note. We reviewed the outline and are excited about a co-bundle. Quick answers below:

- Telemetry: We can commit to supporting open tracing headers and a lightweight span emitter by GA (end of Q3). We cannot take on sampling logic in-host; we’d prefer Redwood control sampling at the gateway.
- Packaging: LlamaLink prefers a co-branded SDK (single artifact) for the initial release — easier for adoption. We are open to a Redwood-hosted wrapper as a phase-2 option.
- Licensing & timeline: Our standard ISV POC window is 90 days; commercial launch thereafter. We can do a pilot pricing suggestion (revenues split 65/35 Redwood/LlamaLink) but that’s flexible pending deal size.

Attaching a short Partner Term sheet and a calendar link for a working session. Evan from Consultly (cc’d) can support drafting a light SOW if you want.

Sofia Herrera
Head of Partnerships, LlamaLink
attachments: LlamaLink-Partner-Terms-v0.3.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Herrera <sofia@llamalink.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LlamaLink co-bundle: commercial packaging, runtime telemetry & responsibilities

Sofia — perfect, thanks for the clarity. A couple of clarifying additions from our side:

- Telemetry split: Redwood will own sampling configuration and telemetry ingestion (we need to keep billing/latency signals centralized). LlamaLink will implement span emitters & schema conformance (we’ll share a light schema).
- SDK artifact: Co-branded single artifact works for GA — we’ll add Redwood feature flags to enable/disable behaviors by tenant.
- Revenue split: fine to start with your 65/35 suggestion for initial anchor deals; Marissa will confirm GTM commitments.

Marissa / Aditya — can we confirm: 1) co-marketing deliverables (joint webinars, one-page case study), 2) standard discount bands for marketplace placements, and 3) whether legal needs a separate IP appendix for the telemetry schema?

I’ll propose a 60-minute working session Wed 11th 1:00pm PT to walk the rolespec and draft term sheet.

Best,

Kimberly
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Herrera <sofia@llamalink.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LlamaLink co-bundle: commercial packaging, runtime telemetry & responsibilities

Thanks Kim / Sofia — happy to own GTM commitments. Quick notes before the call:

- Co-marketing: Redwood will commit to one joint webinar and one case study for the first 6 months post-GA. We can fund a small MDF for event promotion (up to $10k) if LlamaLink can field a customer speaker.
- Marketplace: Standard 15% introductory discount for first 90 days; our marketplace placement team needs a high-res logo and 2-sentence partner blurb.
- Legal/IP: I recommend an IP appendix limiting access to telemetry schemas as "operational metadata" for the co-bundle only. I’ll loop Legal after the working session if you’re okay with that.

Kim — I can take the lead on the co-marketing term-sheet and share a short deck in advance of Wed. Karthik — please bring the telemetry rolespec so we can align on handoffs.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference
attachments: co-marketing-term-sheet.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Herrera <sofia@llamalink.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 May 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LlamaLink co-bundle: commercial packaging, runtime telemetry & responsibilities

Quick technical confirmation following our call notes:

- Telemetry contract: LlamaLink will implement an exporter that surfaces these fields in each span: service.name, span.kind, sequence.prefix, kv_cache.hit_rate (optional), upstream_model_id. Redwood will expose a sampling hint header (X-Redwood-Sample) that the SDK should propagate.
- Backwards compatibility: Implement the exporter behind a feature flag; SDK should no-op if the flag is false. That allows us to release without breaking existing customers.
- Tests: Please include a tiny integration test (bash + curl) that validates span emission and header propagation. We’ll add an acceptance gate on the Redwood side.

I attached a brief rolespec doc with concrete fields and a suggested example curl test. Once we have an agreed doc I can drop a short checklist for engineering to sign off.

Thanks — Karthik
